name: EriTel hosted email and private cloud platform (EriTel datacenters)
notes: Official EriTel pages (verified live 2026-08-12) state EriTel Nextcloud Private Cloud Services and local Email Hosting Services (Axigen, Barracuda gateway, VM replica, weekly backups, 99% uptime) are hosted in EriTel's datacenters; private-cloud tiers 100-500 GB storage / 20-100 users, 10/5 Mbps committed direct connect in Asmara vs 2/2 Mbps remote cities, 90% uptime, up to 6-day RTO. Only verified official datacenter-class signal in Eritrea. Exact facility name/address/racks/MW/redundancy not published; Asmara/Central is strongest locality inference (EriTel HQ in Asmara), exact site undisclosed.

name: Ministry of Health National data centre (planning priority)
notes: First-round discovery lead: Health Sector Strategic Development Plan II 2017-2021 lists 'Setting up National data centre' among health-sector ICT infrastructure priorities. No public capacity, site, procurement or completion evidence found in this method pass; treated as planning intent only, not a verified facility.
